pilgrimage.2003.title: 朝圣：安全问题

source_options.historical_label: 为了我的朝圣之旅，我应该雇佣他们中的一些人。
effects: Visible only when the current travel plan does not already have hire_experienced_mercenaries_option.

Conditional pious_type_option_effect when the current Rite has tenet_armed_pilgrimages, otherwise tenet_struggle_submission; this helper matches Pious/Hajj and changes an activity score, not elapsed travel days.

Add pilgrim_protection_modifier to the current travel plan: travel_safety+10. Remove short-term gold using dynamic minor_gold_value; its income formula/clamps/round-to5 are not a universal75gold cost.
Humble and greedy each supply medium_stress_impact_gain to stress_and_fulfillment_impact. No direct option-level travel delay or Pilgrim/Hajjaj trait grant declared.

source_options.historical_label: 萨阿德丁似乎是一个很棒的家伙。

Remove short-term gold using dynamic minor_gold_value; recruit_to_entourage_court_and_activity_effect targets saved2002_local_warrior. The helper guards court/companion/activity additions; this option was not selected and actual recruitment is unobserved.
Humble and greedy each supply medium_stress_impact_gain. This is the candidate-warrior recruitment option, distinct from A's travel-plan safety modifier.

source_options.historical_label: 不。我坚定地信仰着安拉。
